# ohAegRsaDec

ohAegRsaDec(text: Uint8Array, priKey: string \| Uint8Array): Promise\<Uint8Array\>

RSA3072私钥解密算法，配套[ohAegRsaEnc](https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/AppGallery-connect-References/ohaegrsaenc-0000001864307716)接口使用，密钥类型、填充模式、摘要算法等如下：  

|非对称密钥类型|填充模式|摘要算法|掩码摘要|API版本|
|:------|:---------|:-----|:----------|:----|
|RSA3072|PKCS1_OAEP|SHA256|MGF1_SHA256|11+|

导入模块：

```
import { AegRsa } from '@hw-agconnect/petal-aegis';
```

参数：  

|参数名|类型|必填|说明|
|:-----|:----------------|:-|:------------------------------|
|text|Uint8Array|是|待解密的内容（使用ohAegRsaEnc加密后的结果）。|
|priKey|string或Uint8Array|是|RSA私钥，base64编码过的字符串或Uint8Array。|

返回值：  

|参数|类型|说明|
|:----------|:---------|:--------------------|
|decryptText|Uint8Array|明文普通字符串的Uint8Array格式。|

示例：

```
import { AegRsa } from '@hw-agconnect/petal-aegis';

async function rsa3072_2() {
  let plainText = 'hello world'; //待加密内容
  let plainTextUint8 = new Uint8Array(buffer.from(plainText, 'utf-8').buffer);
  //用于加密的公钥，长度3027位，实际使用时建议使用RSA密钥生成方法生成，不能硬编码在代码中
  let pubKey = '';
  //用于解密的私钥，长度3072位，实际使用时建议使用RSA密钥生成方法生成，不能硬编码在代码中
  let priKey = '';
  try {
    let encryptText = await AegRsa.ohAegRsaEnc(plainTextUint8, pubKey);
    //rsa3072_2  encryptText: 136,144,221,218,241,48,190,163,56,166,207,148,3,174,34,62,129,200,107,3,103,216,231,148,127,31,126,51,158,66,57,18,188,121,92,96,235,124,224,134,188,160,27,209,59,45,174,197,135,1,150,226,11,195,127,154,101,162,251,113,84,5,205,177,182,93,115,186,71,175,50,119,136,16,204,118,92,145,144,148,147,196,103,215,24,61,151,204,115,177,62,13,190,147,166,98,178,218,33,129,209,152,210,74,79,65,128,225,201,74,105,79,210,32,1,63,22,45,121,161,97,152,49,252,88,250,133,105,183,232,252,222,23,120,120,181,98,18,180,64,112,223,228,152,30,24,161,245,247,16,195,88,87,216,136,218,112,164,208,241,227,204,147,238,64,54,100,17,196,133,119,70,26,35,233,179,243,15,103,127,63,103,231,1,195,171,160,226,22,145,56,72,93,219,48,250,239,50,176,182,99,8,120,99,209,197,90,243,149,105,43,254,50,100,186,173,68,144,98,97,140,215,179,20,41,29,207,199,62,253,114,70,242,186,155,10,241,244,83,46,18,204,218,87,152,24,178,38,232,169,253,254,0,25,131,229,119,78,248,141,134,174,204,216,13,202,69,139,205,86,63,131,248,197,190,0,4,75,93,140,15,117,33,5,35,209,119,211,31,174,230,173,11,16,154,85,202,26,213,155,107,28,35,17,66,129,233,50,109,154,152,191,122,251,116,52,90,208,247,70,115,17,94,4,43,242,137,183,104,145,252,143,171,189,194,34,66,88,245,45,61,68,250,25,222,41,237,226,92,130,66,92,48,150,228,247,162,125,92,100,166,120,10,117,224,251,198,86,105,105,161,85,198,211,91,33,227,34,69,208,142,126,105,104
    console.log("rsa3072_2 ", 'encryptText: ' + encryptText);

    let decryptText = await AegRsa.ohAegRsaDec(encryptText, priKey);
    if (plainText === uint8ArrayToString(decryptText)) {
      console.info('rsa3072_2 decrypt ok');
    }
    console.log("rsa3072_2 ", 'decryptText: ' + uint8ArrayToString(decryptText));
  } catch (err) {
    console.log("rsa3072_2 ", 'err: ' + err);
  }
}

function uint8ArrayToString(data: Uint8Array) {
  let dataString = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
    dataString += String.fromCharCode(data[i]);
  }
  return dataString;
}
```
